title: Glass launcher menu over dark bloom wallpaper (Wuthering Waves themed)
contains_third_party_content: Game promotional art and a character avatar appear inside the mockup; do not redistribute the image.

color.method: Pixel sampling via median-cut quantization of the supplied JPEG/GIF (compressed images, so values are approximate within a few units). Entries marked 'approx' were judged by eye, not sampled.
palette: window controls, the only chroma in the UI
color.roles: Achromatic system. Panel is a translucent dark-grey glass; text white. Only chromatic accents are the traffic-light dots and the promo banner image.

observed.layout: Single narrow vertical panel (~2:5 ratio) with large corner radius. Top-to-bottom: window controls, avatar + name + UID, hairline divider, 'MENU' label, 5 nav rows, divider, promo banner card, divider, Settings and Log out.
observed.hierarchy: Name is the largest text. Menu rows are uniform size. The active row ('Start') is marked by an outlined, lightly filled glass pill, not by color. A white circular badge ('4') on News is the highest-contrast small element.
observed.typography: Humanist-style sans with slightly flared strokes (reads as Gill Sans-like). Typeface unconfirmed. Mixed case labels, small uppercase section label.
observed.iconography: Mixed styles: mostly monoline outline (account, cart, gear) with a filled cursor and two icons that are small illustrations (News, Waveplate), so icon style is inconsistent.
observed.materials: Frosted glass: background blur, thin light border, visible soft shadow of the wallpaper forms through the panel.
observed.background: Soft black 3D bloom/ribbon wallpaper on grey, which gives the glass something to refract.

interpretation.aesthetic: Dark glassmorphism with a desktop-OS feel (macOS-style window dots). Gaming-launcher context: a promo banner and profile UID signal a game/account hub.
implementation_notes: Glass panel: backdrop-filter blur(20-40px) with a low-alpha dark background, 1px rgba(255,255,255,0.2-0.3) border, optional inset highlight.
Active row: border + slightly lighter translucent fill rather than a solid color; works because the surface itself is neutral.
Badge: fixed-size circle, white fill, dark numeral.
interpretation.caveat: All implementation notes are Claude's interpretation of the image, not from the creator.

concept_work.essence: A calm, monochrome glass menu whose only emphasis tools are shape, border and one white badge.
what_makes_it_work: Restraint: one neutral palette lets the promo art be the only color moment.
Consistent row rhythm and generous padding make 8+ items scannable.
Dividers group profile / navigation / promo / system actions clearly.
gaps_to_make_it_work: Glass over a busy or bright wallpaper can drop text contrast below accessible levels; needs a fallback solid scrim.
Active state relies on a subtle outline only, which is weak for low-vision users.
Mixed icon styles weaken the system.
backdrop-filter is costly on low-end devices.

lessons: In a neutral glass UI, use border + fill for state and reserve color for content.
Glass needs a controlled backdrop or a contrast-safe scrim to be shippable.
open_questions: Is there code or a prototype?
